newsitem.title: USA: UROHEALTH Systems signs supply contract.
newsitem.headline: UROHEALTH Systems signs supply contract.

text.p: UROHEALTH Systems Inc on Friday said it has signed a contract to provide surgical specialty products to 466 acute care facilities and 218 surgery centers that receive supplies from Purchase Connection, a division of COHR Inc.
The agreement is retroactive to April 1, and will run for three years. The market potential for the deal is about $4.5 million a year, UROHEALTH said in a statement.
UROHEALTH makes and markets disease specific urological, gynecological and general surgery products.
